graph.name: CodeArchitect AI (this repo)
graph.description: 35 components mapped by Claude Code; edges derived from real imports plus HTTP calls.

data.label: Workspace Page
data.description: Composition root: owns the reducer, derives the render graph, and runs every async flow (impact, story, scaffold, import, export) with stale-result guards.

data.label: Top Navigation
data.description: Repository selector (samples, imported graph, Custom Upload), engine badge, and the three global actions.

data.label: Architecture Canvas
data.description: Controlled React Flow canvas: background, controls, minimap, legends; forwards node changes, selection and new connections.

data.label: Component Node
data.description: Custom node card: kind colour, status dot/glow, quick actions injected through NodeActionsContext.

data.label: Inspector Drawer
data.description: Tabbed right drawer routing workspace state into the four mode panels.

data.label: Node Inspector Tab
data.description: Code, exports, imports, params and dependency links for the selected component.

data.label: Blast Radius Tab
data.description: Prompt box, risk meter, affected-component list and diffs for an impact analysis.

data.label: Story Tab
data.description: Time-machine transport controls, commit timeline, narration and git-log importer.

data.label: Builder Tab
data.description: Add draft components, list draft edges, generate and apply scaffolding.

data.label: Diff Viewer
data.description: Collapsible side-by-side diff cards built on the LCS line diff.

data.label: Code Block
data.description: Line-numbered code view with lightweight lexical highlighting and copy button.

data.label: Import Dialog
data.description: Modal for ZIP/JSON drop and GitHub URL submission.

data.label: POST /api/impact
data.description: Validates the graph + prompt, then Claude or the local impact engine.

data.label: POST /api/story
data.description: Narrates commit history with Claude, or echoes commit-derived narratives.

data.label: POST /api/scaffold
data.description: Generates files for draft components and wiring edits.

data.label: POST /api/analyze-repo
data.description: Ingests uploaded files or a GitHub archive into an architecture graph.

data.label: GET /api/health
data.description: Reports whether Claude is enabled and which model.

data.label: Workspace Reducer
data.description: Single reducer for all UI state: graph, selection, impact, story, builder, notices.

data.label: Render View-Model
data.description: Pure overlay of impact/story/draft status onto nodes and edges (precedence: story > impact > draft).

data.label: API Client
data.description: Typed fetch wrappers; falls back to in-browser engines when the server is unreachable.

data.label: Export / Import
data.description: ZIP export of all component code plus manifest; restores graphs from JSON or exported ZIPs.

data.label: Graph Algorithms
data.description: Reverse-dependency BFS, impact-path edges, layered layout, identifier extraction.

data.label: Line Diff (LCS)
data.description: O(n·m) LCS edit script paired into aligned side-by-side rows.

data.label: Local Impact Engine
data.description: Scenario matching, prompt→root ranking, BFS severities, risk score, heuristic diffs.

data.label: Story Engine
data.description: git log parser, path→node matching, per-frame visibility.

data.label: Heuristic Repo Mapper
data.description: File filtering, path classification, import resolution and export extraction for repo ingestion.

data.label: Scaffold Templates
data.description: Per-kind code templates and wiring edits for draft components.

data.label: ZIP Reader
data.description: JSZip extraction with size caps and GitHub top-folder stripping.

data.label: Graph Schema (zod)
data.description: Bounded zod schema for graphs; shared by API validation and JSON import.

data.label: API Request Schemas
data.description: Request validation and Claude structured-output schemas.

data.label: Route Responder
data.description: Body parsing, error envelopes, and Claude→local fallback orchestration.

data.label: Claude Analyzers
data.description: Prompts for impact/story/scaffold/ingest; validates Claude output against the graph.

data.label: Claude API Gateway
data.description: Anthropic SDK client: model choice, structured output, refusal fallback, error mapping. External dependency.

data.label: GitHub Archive Fetcher
data.description: SSRF-safe zipball download from api.github.com. External dependency.

data.label: Sample Repositories
data.description: Built-in E-Commerce and Auth sample graphs, prompts and scenarios.

commits.author: imhussain001
commits.message: chore: scaffold Next.js 16 app with Tailwind 4, React Flow and Vitest
commits.narrative: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind 4, React Flow 12 and Vitest are pinned before any feature code. No architectural components exist yet.

commits.author: imhussain001
commits.message: feat(domain): add graph types and sample repositories
commits.narrative: The project starts data-first: a typed graph model where node status is derived, never stored, plus two hand-written sample repositories so every later layer has realistic input.

commits.author: imhussain001
commits.message: feat(engines): add graph traversal, line diff and local analysis engines
commits.narrative: All analysis logic lands as pure, isomorphic functions before any UI exists: reverse-dependency BFS, LCS diff, impact scoring, git-log parsing, repo heuristics and scaffold templates. This is what lets the app run fully offline and fall back in the browser.

commits.author: imhussain001
commits.message: feat(api): add Claude-backed analysis routes with local fallback
commits.narrative: The server wraps the engines: each route validates input with zod, tries Claude with structured outputs, and degrades to the local engine with a visible warning. Claude output is never trusted for node IDs or 'before' code.

commits.author: imhussain001
commits.message: feat(ui): add workspace dashboard with canvas, inspector tabs and builder
commits.narrative: A single reducer and a pure view-model drive the canvas and the four inspector tabs; import/export closes the loop so analysed graphs can be saved and restored.

commits.author: imhussain001
commits.message: fix(diff): wrap long lines so before/after columns stay aligned
commits.narrative: Browser testing showed long lines bleeding from the Before column into After. The fix moves to one shared grid with wrapping cells — a bug no unit test would have caught.

scenarios.title: Return a plain Record from collectDependents
scenarios.summary: Changing `collectDependents` from `Map<string, number>` to `Record<string, number>` breaks exactly two callers that use Map methods: the local impact engine (`.entries()`, `.has()`) and the Claude analyzers (`.get()`). Other importers of lib/graph.ts (layout, edge highlighting, node lookup) are unaffected but sit in the same module, so they are flagged for review only.

diffs.rationale: New return type; property access replaces Map methods.
Iterate with Object.entries and test membership with `in`.

scenarios.title: Make the Claude model configurable
scenarios.summary: Reading the model from `CODEARCHITECT_MODEL` is a one-line change in the Claude gateway. No caller breaks at compile time, but every Claude-backed route changes behaviour and cost, and `/api/health` reports the configured model. Note that `fallbacks: "default"` and adaptive thinking rules differ per model; verify the chosen model supports them.

diffs.rationale: Env override with the current default.

warnings: lib/types.ts and lib/ui.ts are omitted: nearly every module imports them, which would add ~30 edges of noise. app/layout.tsx and lib/mock/* are folded into neighbouring components.
